bio: This restaurant enjoys a gorgeous location in a modern cuboid building by the monastery pond – the terrace affords stunning views of the surroundings. Inside, you can peek into the kitchen and watch freshly caught fish being grilled over an open charcoal flame. Specialities such as char tartare, teriyaki‑glazed fillet of stick‑grilled fish, or milkmaid-style trout all feature fish from the restaurant's own on-site fish farm – talk about local sourcing! The extensive à la carte selection caters not just to fish enthusiasts but also features vegetarian options and meat dishes. Cap off your meal with house-made Tyrolean milk soft ice cream. Tip: Located on the Inn River cycle route, this place is the perfect spot for a mid-ride pit stop....
